invariants.rationale: Method behavior assumes writeMetadata is provided and needed for constructing the result.
Method always returns a new TableWriteStats object, so result should never be null.
getWriteStatuses() is called on writeMetadata and then streamed, which would throw if null.
Each WriteStatus in writeMetadata produces a stat in result via mapping.
Each stat is derived from WriteStatus.getStat(), which is likely non-null as part of the mapping.
